transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, September 9. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Dilip Gavit's journey: From losing right arm to raising the tricolour on podiums. A childhood accident cost Dilip Gavit his right arm, but it could not take away his ambition. From a tribal hamlet in Nashik to a Commonwealth Games record in Glasgow, the 23-year-old's journey has been shaped by resilience, a life-changing coach and an unlikely switch from the 400m to the 100m. The 23-year-old now aims for glory at the Asian Games. Uber's layoff memo also has a work from home message for remaining 29,000 employees. Uber is cutting about 3,300 jobs, roughly 10 percent of its workforce, but chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi's email to staff carries a second decision for everyone who stays. Uber is ending work from home for all but 1 percent of employees, asking remote staff to move to an office near their team. The three-day hybrid policy stays, and Uber will enforce it, with global teams concentrated in New York and San Francisco. Watch: US strikes 5 Iranian oil tankers near Kharg after IRGC targeted navy warships. Donald Trump's fury toward Iran continued on Tuesday as the US launched an attack targeting multiple Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island in the Persian Gulf. 'We have nothing to lose': Babar Azam rallies Pakistan for Edgbaston Test. Pakistan captain Babar Azam wants his team to play freely in the final Test. The Pakistan Cricket Board made significant changes after two heavy defeats. Seven players were released and new faces joined the touring squad. Babar Azam expressed surprise at the mid-series squad overhaul. UPI-ng the ante: PM Modi wants desi connect with global pay. MUMBAI: PM Narendra Modi Tuesday called for India to set its own standards and protocols for cross-border payments and directly integrate its payment system with countries where Indian diaspora populations are large and trade volumes significant. Apple iPhone 18 Pro, Ultra launch on September 9: Expected specifications, price. Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event is scheduled for September 9, introducing new iPhones. The lineup includes the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone Ultra. The standard iPhone 18 models are delayed until spring 2027, impacting the autumn pricing strategy. New Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 are also expected at the event. Building collapses to fires, 33k died in 5 years from 2020. NEW DELHI: Between 2020 and 2024, nearly 33,000 people died across the country in incidents involving building collapses, fires and falls into pits and manholes, according to govt data. Ontario couple donates 187-acre Wilson Island sanctuary bought in 1989. Jim and Anne Purvis bought 187.4 acres on Ontario's Wilson Island in 1989 and spent 36 years protecting the land as a family sanctuary. They have now donated the property to the Northumberland Land Trust, ensuring its forests, wetlands, grasslands and habitats for species at risk remain protected as a permanent nature reserve. Putin meeting PM Modi on Friday; energy, defence high on agenda. Russia described as illegal and unacceptable the US move to impose 100 percent tariffs on nations importing Russian oil, while confirming another bilateral meeting between PM Modi and President Vladimir Putin on Friday. Nicolas Cage's $10.5m Malibu mansion hit by massive 30ft sinkhole. Nicolas Cage's $10.5 million Malibu mansion has been hit by a massive sinkhole, with photos showing the driveway collapsing amid suspected coastal erosion. According to KTLA, the crater measures around 30 feet by 30 feet. The 4,000-square-foot beachfront property was purchased by Cage in 2024 and features dramatic ocean views and a rooftop deck. How WhatsApp messages led to former USCIS official in $960,000 citizenship scam. A former USCIS official and an accomplice face federal charges for a bribery scheme. They allegedly accepted nearly $960,000 to manipulate immigration applications. Investigators used thousands of WhatsApp messages and calls to trace the alleged scam. The scheme involved bypassing standard procedures and speeding up citizenship cases. BJP got rupees 1,473 crore to fight Bengal, Assam, 3 other assembly polls. NEW DELHI: Total receipts by BJP's central party headquarters during the last round of assembly polls in Bengal, Assam, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry stood at rupees 1,472.8 crore, as per the party's election expenditure statements for Assam, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry submitted to the Election Commission.
